front: turn-000.png is the original A-pose file, copied, not scaled.
others: Drawn taller than the A-pose figure, then scaled down so the head sits at y=40 and the feet at y=1681.
eyes: Open. Gaze goes with the head, not at the camera. Amber is her right eye. Green is her left eye. 90 and 270 are separate drawings, not mirrors.
hair: High bun, short strands, no wind, no long hair.
hands: A-pose rest. Slight spread, same soft curl, thumb in the same place.
seam: 90 and 270 are one drawing each. The front three-quarter and back views add the calves under the knees, so a faint join can still show there.
